saw.short: A creator calls a Suffolk pumpkin patch the UK's “most depressing”
saw.headline: A creator calls a Suffolk pumpkin patch the *UK's “most depressing”*
saw.what: Instagram creator @alexdodman posted “a real review” of Suffolk's Pumpkin Patch in Barton Mills, with “Glasgow Willy Wonka vibes”. He said it cost £19.52 for a family of five. The family-run organisers, in their first year, replied: “At the end of the day we are only humans.”
saw.why: Half-term days out are under the microscope. Honest reviews of family attractions travel fast in Halloween week.

saw.short: Dune: Part Three IMAX 70mm tickets spark huge UK online queues
saw.headline: Dune: Part Three tickets spark *huge online queues*
saw.what: IMAX 70mm tickets went on sale on Tuesday morning at only three UK cinemas: BFI IMAX, the Science Museum and Vue Manchester Printworks. One X user claimed “at least 65,000 people” were in the BFI queue in the first minute. The film opens on 18 Dec.
saw.why: Queue screenshots are content in their own right. Fans turn a ticket sale into a shared event.

saw.short: SNL UK calls out Shane Gillis, and UK viewers feel “patriotic”
saw.headline: SNL UK calls out Shane Gillis, and viewers feel *“patriotic”*
saw.what: Cast member Ania Magliano used a mock news segment to answer Shane Gillis's controversial monologue on the US show, with a photo of him on screen and some strong language. Viewers replied “suddenly i'm patriotic” and “That's not a jab that's a knock out”.
saw.why: UK audiences love a home-grown answer to a US moment. Local takes on global rows get shared.

saw.short: Elizabeth Holmes's stare in a Nathan Fielder teaser feels “uncanny valley”
saw.headline: Elizabeth Holmes's stare in a new teaser feels *“uncanny valley”*
saw.what: The teaser for Nathan Fielder's documentary You Can See Everything shows Holmes asking him: “Why would I deceive you?” Viewers called it “creepy and awkward” and “uncanny valley”. Microexpressions expert Annie Särnblad broke down the stare on Instagram after a “ton of DMs”.
saw.why: One unsettling expression became a format: experts and creators react to the clip frame by frame.

platform.short: TikTok Shop adds shoppable carousels and group deals for UK sellers
platform.headline: TikTok Shop adds *shoppable carousels* for UK sellers
platform.what: UK merchants can now post shoppable carousels of two or more images (five to seven recommended). New live tools include group deals that unlock a discount at a sales target, “second chance” auctions and stock reserved for lives.
platform.why: Carousels become a shopping format on TikTok in the UK, just in time for Christmas gifting.

platform.short: YouTube Shopping adds AliExpress, including in the UK
platform.headline: YouTube Shopping adds *AliExpress*, including in the UK
platform.what: Creators in the US, Brazil, the UK and Germany can now tag AliExpress products through YouTube's affiliate programme. It launched in South Korea in March. UK creators joined the affiliate programme in August, and YouTube aims for 35 markets by the end of 2026.
platform.why: More creators can earn from product tags, so expect more haul and try-on videos in the run-up to Christmas.

platform.short: Snap hires Robert Downey Jr to sell its Specs glasses
platform.headline: Snap hires *Robert Downey Jr* to sell its Specs glasses
platform.what: Robert Downey Jr is Snap's new “Chief Customer Experience Officer” for Specs, its AR glasses. He'll front original video episodes on the Specs site and YouTube. Specs are on pre-order in the US at $2,195.
platform.why: A celebrity title instead of a plain ad. Expect more brands to give famous faces made-up job titles.

watch.title: Clocks go back
watch.note: The first dark evenings. A natural hook for cosy-night, home and comfort content.

watch.title: October half-term
watch.note: Half-term in most of England; academies set their own dates. Family days out and home plans fill feeds.

watch.title: Instagram removes Reels series links
watch.note: Check any posts or plans that rely on linking Reels in a series.

watch.title: Halloween
watch.note: Content peaks from Thursday. Get costume and Halloween posts out early.

watch.title: £100 fines for loud phones on buses
watch.note: The government's “Share the journey, not the noise” push started on 19 Oct. Fines still need the Transport Secretary's sign-off.

desks.watch: Keep posts about Hexed. Don't name rival films or tie Disney to the Holmes story itself.

ideas.note: A cosy, timely recipe for Sunday night.
